## Liminate agreement corpus.
##
## The subset: `about`, `--` comments, `remember a number|text|truth called ...`,
## and `forbid|require|permit <condition> [unless <condition>] because "..."`.
## Every program here is run through the reference interpreter by
## scripts/gen_agreement_corpus.py; what it did is written to
## tests/fixtures/agreement-<version>.json, and the TypeScript and Swift
## evaluators must reproduce it exactly. Nothing outside the subset belongs here:
## a port rejects those on purpose, and the reference would accept them.
##
## Mixed `and` / `or` in one condition is out of the subset for the same reason:
## the reference stops to ask which way to read it (an amber outcome), and an
## agreement that depends on that reading is not one a floor should rest on.
##

# number is: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is 5 because "equals five"

# number is: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is 4 because "equals four"

# number above: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 4 because "rule above"

# number above: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 5 because "rule above"

# number below: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is below 6 because "rule below"

# number below: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is below 5 because "rule below"

# number equal to: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is equal to 5 because "rule equal to"

# number equal to: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is equal to 4 because "rule equal to"

# number not above: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not above 5 because "rule not above"

# number not above: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not above 4 because "rule not above"

# number not below: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not below 5 because "rule not below"

# number not below: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not below 6 because "rule not below"

# number not equal to: crosses
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not equal to 4 because "rule not equal to"

# number not equal to: does not cross
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is not equal to 5 because "rule not equal to"

# boundary: equal to the limit is not above it
remember a number called n with 3.0
forbid n is above 3 because "limit"

# boundary: just past the limit is above it
remember a number called n with 3.1
forbid n is above 3 because "limit"

# boundary: zero against above zero
remember a number called n with 0
forbid n is above 0 because "any"

# negative numbers
remember a number called n with -5
forbid n is below 0 because "negative"

# decimals compare as numbers
remember a number called n with 2.5
forbid n is above 2.5 because "not past"
forbid n is not below 2.5 because "at or past"

# integer and decimal are equal
remember a number called n with 3
forbid n is equal to 3.0 because "same number"

# a large number
remember a number called n with 1000000
forbid n is above 999999 because "large"

# within: inside the tolerance
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is within 1 of 4 because "near four"

# within: outside the tolerance
remember a number called n with 9
forbid n is within 1 of 4 because "near four"

# text equality: crosses
remember a text called mood with "calm"
forbid mood is "calm" because "calm is forbidden"

# text equality: does not cross
remember a text called mood with "calm"
forbid mood is "angry" because "angry is forbidden"

# text not equal to
remember a text called mood with "calm"
forbid mood is not equal to "angry" because "anything but angry"

# text against a bareword
remember a text called mood with "calm"
forbid mood is calm because "bareword compares as text"

# text with a space
remember a text called city with "new york"
forbid city is "new york" because "a space inside the value"

# text is case sensitive
remember a text called mood with "Calm"
forbid mood is "calm" because "case"

# truth is true: crosses
remember a truth called flag with true
forbid flag is true because "flag set"

# truth is true: does not cross
remember a truth called flag with false
forbid flag is true because "flag set"

# require a truth
remember a truth called ready with false
require ready is true because "must be ready"

# require: met
remember a number called n with 5
require n is above 1 because "at least two"

# require: unmet
remember a number called n with 5
require n is below 2 because "under two"

# permit: never crosses
remember a number called n with 5
permit n is above 1 because "allowed"

# permit: true condition
remember a number called n with 5
permit n is above 4 because "allowed"
permit n is below 1 because "not applicable"

# and: both true
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 and n is below 9 because "in the band"

# and: one false
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 and n is below 3 because "in the band"

# or: one true
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 9 or n is below 6 because "either side"

# or: both false
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 9 or n is below 1 because "either side"

# and across two facts
remember a number called a-count with 2
remember a number called b-count with 7
forbid a-count is above 1 and b-count is above 6 because "both counts high"

# unless: excuses the rule
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 3 unless n is above 4 because "excused"

# unless: does not excuse
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 3 unless n is above 9 because "not excused"

# require with unless
remember a number called n with 5
require n is below 2 unless n is above 4 because "excused"

# a rule that compares two facts
remember a number called used with 8
remember a number called allowed with 5
forbid used is above allowed because "over the allowance"

# a fact remembered twice keeps the last value
remember a number called n with 1
remember a number called n with 9
forbid n is above 5 because "last value wins"

# a fact remembered after the rule is not seen by it
remember a number called n with 1
forbid n is above 5 because "uses what is known at this point"
remember a number called n with 9

# several rules crossing are reported in program order
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 because "first"
forbid n is below 1 because "second, does not cross"
forbid n is above 2 because "third"
require n is below 3 because "fourth"

# no rule crossing
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 9 because "one"
forbid n is below 1 because "two"
require n is above 0 because "three"
permit n is above 0 because "four"

# only a required rule is unmet
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 9 because "fine"
require n is below 2 because "unmet"

# the same condition twice reports twice, each with its own because
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 because "first reason"
forbid n is above 1 because "second reason"

# comments and blank lines are not statements
-- A header comment.
about "comment-case"

-- another comment
remember a number called n with 5

forbid n is above 1 because "comments do not matter"
-- a trailing comment

# about alone
about "nothing-else"

# an empty-looking program of comments
-- only a comment

# because text with punctuation
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 because "more than one (WCAG 2.3.1), see: the rule; it's firm"

# a rule without a because
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1

# a hyphenated and digit-bearing name
remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 4
remember a number called count2 with 1
forbid flashes-in-worst-second is above 3 because "hyphens are fine"
forbid count2 is above 3 because "digits are fine"

# error: a fact that was never remembered
remember a number called n with 5
forbid missing is above 1 because "no such fact"

# error: a missing fact does not hide a crossing elsewhere
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 because "crosses"
forbid missing is above 1 because "no such fact"

# error: a range comparison over text
remember a text called mood with "calm"
forbid mood is above 3 because "text has no order"

# error: with and no value
remember a number called n with
forbid n is above 1 because "the fact never existed"

# error: a reserved word as a name
remember a number called and with 5
forbid and is above 1 because "reserved"

# error: a rule with no condition
remember a number called n with 5
forbid because "nothing to test"

# error: an unterminated because
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above 1 because "never closed

# error: a sentence that is not a statement
remember a number called n with 5
the quick brown fox
forbid n is above 1 because "after the noise"

# error: an unknown comparison word
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is around 5 because "not a comparison"

# error: a number written as text compared by order
remember a number called n with 5
forbid n is above "3" because "quoted number"

# cuecue: nothing crossed
about "cuecue-floor-v1"
remember a number called phone-numbers with 0
remember a number called email-addresses with 0
remember a number called loud-seconds with 0.0
remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 0
remember a number called dead-picture-seconds with 0.0
forbid phone-numbers is above 0 because "a phone number spoken in a public cue"
forbid email-addresses is above 0 because "an email address spoken in a public cue"
forbid loud-seconds is above 3 because "sustained volume past the floor"
forbid flashes-in-worst-second is above 3 because "more than three flashes in one second (WCAG 2.3.1)"
forbid dead-picture-seconds is above 10 because "more than ten seconds of black or frozen picture"

# cuecue: boundaries exactly at the limits pass
about "cuecue-floor-v1"
remember a number called phone-numbers with 0
remember a number called email-addresses with 0
remember a number called loud-seconds with 3.0
remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 3
remember a number called dead-picture-seconds with 10.0
forbid phone-numbers is above 0 because "a phone number spoken in a public cue"
forbid email-addresses is above 0 because "an email address spoken in a public cue"
forbid loud-seconds is above 3 because "sustained volume past the floor"
forbid flashes-in-worst-second is above 3 because "more than three flashes in one second (WCAG 2.3.1)"
forbid dead-picture-seconds is above 10 because "more than ten seconds of black or frozen picture"

remember a number called phone-numbers with 1
remember a number called email-addresses with 0
remember a number called loud-seconds with 0.0
remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 0
remember a number called dead-picture-seconds with 0.0
forbid phone-numbers is above 0 because "a phone number spoken in a public cue"
forbid email-addresses is above 0 because "an email address spoken in a public cue"
forbid loud-seconds is above 3 because "sustained volume past the floor"
forbid flashes-in-worst-second is above 3 because "more than three flashes in one second (WCAG 2.3.1)"
forbid dead-picture-seconds is above 10 because "more than ten seconds of black or frozen picture"

remember a number called loud-seconds with 0.0

# cuecue: three and four crossed together
about "cuecue-floor-v1"
remember a number called phone-numbers with 0
remember a number called email-addresses with 0

remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 4

# cuecue: every rule crossed
about "cuecue-floor-v1"
remember a number called phone-numbers with 2
remember a number called email-addresses with 1
remember a number called loud-seconds with 9.5
remember a number called flashes-in-worst-second with 7
remember a number called dead-picture-seconds with 30.0
forbid phone-numbers is above 0 because "a phone number spoken in a public cue"
forbid email-addresses is above 0 because "an email address spoken in a public cue"

forbid dead-picture-seconds is above 10 because "more than ten seconds of black or frozen picture"
